Chapter 404: Chapter 15 Guidance and Planning (Please Subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred slightly, and he transmitted the secret technique he had just comprehended directly into Mo Li’s sea of consciousness.

Comprehending this secret technique did not consume too much of Lin Yuan’s energy, after all, it didn’t need to be widely applicable, it just had to suit Mo Li’s condition.

Moreover, Lin Yuan was already at the pinnacle of the seventh rank, while Mo Li was only fourth rank, so it wasn’t an exaggeration to say that guiding from a higher plane was a simple and easy task.

“This secret technique?”

Mo Li glanced briefly at the evolution secret skill that surged into his mind and was immediately shocked.

He could feel that this secret technique was extremely compatible with him, as if it were tailor-made for him.

...

This was utterly inconceivable.

You must know, although evolution secret techniques were far from having as significant an impact as evolution paths on evolvers,

choosing the right secret technique suited to oneself could often lead to twice the result with half the effort.

However, with secret techniques vast as fireworks, how to choose a suitable secret technique for comprehension was a massive challenge.

Each evolver’s condition is different, experiences vary, and physical constitutions are vastly diverse, even for an invincible eighth-layer being like the Chikun Star Lord.

Choosing a suitable secret technique for a disciple also required time to observe.

Even then, the evolution secret technique chosen in the end was not wholly compatible with oneself.

To find a secret technique that perfectly matches one would need luck.

But now, Mo Li felt that the evolution secret technique bestowed by the Thirteen Peaks Peak Master was perfectly aligned with him.

This simply made it hard for him to believe.

“Wrong, wrong, the outside world sees the Thirteen Peaks Peak Master as a freak of talent and aptitude, but now it seems, the Master’s methods of instructing disciples are also…”

Mo Li was inwardly excited, yet he did not know how to describe it. Merely observing him for a while, the Peak Master had selected an evolution secret technique that was a perfect fit for him, a method that indeed defied common sense.

What Mo Li did not know was that this secret technique wasn’t picked out by Lin Yuan at all, but was comprehended on the spot based on the state of his physical soul.

“This secret technique is a secret of the Thirteen Peaks, do not divulge it,” said Lin Yuan, noticing that Mo Li was lost in thought, as he reminded him.

“Yes.”

“Thank you, Master, for your great kindness.”

Mo Li immediately came to his senses and knelt to kowtow on the ground.

The most important aspect of a teacher instructing a disciple is guidance. For Lin Yuan to select an evolution secret technique that perfectly matched Mo Li was akin to being reborn.

How could Mo Li not know the grace bestowed by Lin Yuan?

“Hmm.”

Lin Yuan nodded, his gaze shifting to Wu Lan beside him.

“Peak Master.” Wu Lan immediately called out anxiously.

Seeing Mo Li’s excited demeanor and his expression almost chanting ‘the Great Dao is within grasp,’ Wu Lan felt even more puzzled, as she was the most ordinary Silver Pattern Challenger, already feeling immense pressure facing Mo Li, a Red Pattern individual.

“You are cultivating the Martial Path Evolutionary Path?” Lin Yuan looked towards Wu Lan and asked.

Having watched Wu Lan’s trial video in the Seven Star Cave World, Lin Yuan knew the path she had taken.

Of course, Wu Lan’s final choice of rule was not Taiyin and Taiyang but the water rule from the basic Five Elements.

“Yes.”

Wu Lan immediately responded.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path was popular in the Chikun Star Domain, albeit with not many strong practitioners, as it had only surfaced not long ago.

“Water nourishes all things without a sound. Your path should be based on the Rule of Water, comprehending deeply the other four elements of metal, wood, fire, and earth…”

Lin Yuan pondered for a while. As the founder of Martial Tao, perhaps no other evolver in the world understood it better than he. With one glance, he laid out Wu Lan’s future cultivation plan.

At the same time.

With a point of his right hand, Lin Yuan transmitted an evolution secret technique to guide Wu Lan’s cultivation into her sea of consciousness.

If Wu Lan could reach a certain depth in the Five Elements Rules of metal, wood, water, fire, earth by the sixth rank, and also gain a basic understanding of the space rules, comprehending the fundamental spatial model,

she might be able to create a small Five Elements World at the pinnacle of the sixth rank, but Lin Yuan felt that given Wu Lan’s displayed talent and aptitude, it would be hard to achieve this goal.

If not at the sixth rank, then at the seventh, the method of “opening the realm” with the Five Elements Rules plus the space rules was set, and Wu Lan’s future path should not encounter any significant problems.

“This…”

Wu Lan’s eyes widened, the evolution secret technique Lin Yuan transmitted into her mind was crystal clear, like the ultimate truths of evolution manifested.

At this moment, Wu Lan finally understood why Mo Li, as a Red Pattern Challenger, had shown such an expression.

It was the excitement of seeing one’s future path, and the thrill of understanding the Dao that made life worth living even if death followed hearing it in the evening.

“`

“Thank you for the guidance, Peak Master…”

“`

“`

Without hesitation, Wu Lan knelt on the ground and gave a kowtow.

“`

“`

“Very well.”

“`

“`

“You two practice diligently.”

“`

“`

Lin Yuan waved his hand, signaling them to leave.

“`

“`

It wasn’t until Mo Li and Wu Lan had left that Lin Yuan withdrew his gaze.

“`

“`

“I hope you two won’t disappoint me,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

“`

“`

…

“`

“`

Chikun Main Star.

“`

“`

Deep within the Thirteen Peaks Great Hall.

“`

“`

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, his mind observing the ‘Magic Jade Mark’ branded within his soul.

“`

“`

“This ‘Magic Jade Mark’ is connected to that Mysterious Space…”

“`

“`

Lin Yuan’s thoughts drifted, and he faintly perceived through the ‘Magic Jade Mark’ a vast and mysterious space.

“`

“`

This Mysterious Space was completely closed off. Even sensing its existence, one could not enter, not even a Supreme Being, unless they had the Magic Jade Mark as the key to explore it.

“`

“`

“In fact, the current Human Civilization’s Evolvers who contemplate the Evolution Path enveloped within that segment of the body are not wrong in their approach,” Lin Yuan silently mused.

“`

“`

To condense the Magic Jade Mark, one needed to follow one of two methods.

“`

“`

One was like Lin Yuan, who fathomed all three thousand three hundred thirty-three Evolution Paths.

“`

“`

The other was to choose one Evolution Path to cultivate, continuously perfecting and supplementing this path until the end, which could also result in the condensation of the Magic Jade Mark.

“`

“`

Presently, most Evolvers of Human Civilization followed the second method.

“`

“`

However, thus far, not a single Evolver had succeeded in traversing it completely, and the vast majority had failed utterly.

“`

“`

As for the first method… Lin Yuan, who possessed an Against-Heaven’s Understanding, managed to achieve it, a feat difficult for other Evolvers of the Human Alliance to replicate.

“`

“`

“Still, I should inform the Goddess of Wisdom; it’s at least another path,” Lin Yuan reflected and made up his mind.

“`

“`

According to the rules set by the Three Goddesses, anyone who could benefit the Human Civilization Alliance would receive Merit Points as a reward.

“`

“`

The Human Civilization Alliance wouldn’t let down any Evolvers who made a contribution.

“`

“`

“Goddess of Wisdom.”

“`

“`

Lin Yuan directly contacted the Goddess of Wisdom.

“`

“`

“Respected Seventh-Level Citizen Lin Yuan, the Goddess of Wisdom is pleased to be of service to you…” came the solemn and cool voice of the Goddess of Wisdom.

“`

“`

“I have some information about the body from the Large Alien Battlefield,” Lin Yuan quickly said.

“`

“`

Upon these words.

“`

“`

The Goddess of Wisdom fell into a noticeably silent moment.

“`

“`

Clearly, she had not anticipated that Lin Yuan would speak of this matter, especially since it involved intelligence on the body of a Supreme Being from beyond their world?

“`

“`

“Seventh-Level Citizen Lin Yuan, please proceed,” the Goddess of Wisdom responded.

“`

“`

Lin Yuan could sense the seriousness in the Goddess of Wisdom’s voice and even had the feeling that the Goddess’s main consciousness had descended at this moment.

“`

“`

“I do not know the specifics.”

“`

“`

“What I am certain of is that there are two ways to discern the secrets within that body: one is to cultivate the evolutionary path one has perceived and to follow it to its end.”

“`

“`

“The other is not to cultivate any one evolutionary path but to perceive all three thousand three hundred thirty-three Evolution Paths from that body.”

“`

“`

Lin Yuan concealed the part about the Magic Jade Mark and the Magic Jade Tower.

“`

“`

Without being sure of which power the Magic Jade Tower belonged to, Lin Yuan felt it was best not to reveal this information.

“`

“`

After all, having spoken about the methods, Lin Yuan felt he had done right by his human identity.

“`

“`

“Seventh-Level Citizen Lin Yuan, please wait a moment…”

“`

“`

After speaking, the Goddess of Wisdom fell silent.

“`

“`

Lin Yuan understood that the Goddess of Wisdom was verifying the authenticity of the information he had shared,

“`

“`

The Three Goddesses were no fools; they wouldn’t just take Lin Yuan’s word for it without prior validation.
